kb.name: first Tab reaches SKIP INTRO or skip link
Enter on SKIP ends the intro
Tab walk shows a focus ring on every stop
kb.d: button[radio] "CISO" in #demand [ring] | button[radio] "WINTER" in #demand [ring] | div[button] "Day rose of CISO on 2025-01-02, 00:00: 2" in #demand [ring] | button[radio] "DEMAND" in #netload [ring] | button[radio] "CISO" in #netload [ring] | button[radio] "ALL" in #netload [ring] | div[img] "Mean day of JAN in CISO, demand. Up and " in #netload [ring] | button[radio] "CISO" in #stress [ring] | button[radio] "SUMMER" in #stress [ring] | button[radio] "STACK" in #stress [ring] | button[tab] "1 Renewables +50%" in #stress [ring] | div[button] "Scenario rose. Enter or a click opens th" in #stress [ring] | div[button] "Control room rose. Enter or a click open" in #control [ring] | button[radio] "CISO" in #control [ring]

kb.name: S03a GRID arrow selects ERCO
S03a DAY arrow changes day
S03a Enter on rose opens the inspector and moves focus into it
Esc closes the inspector and returns focus to the rose
kb.d: div[button] "Day rose of ERCO on 2025-04-30, 12:00: 5" in #demand

kb.name: S03b LAYER NET LOAD via keyboard
S03b YEAR 2023 via keyboard
S04 NAIVE toggle via keyboard sets aria-pressed=false
S04 WEEK via keyboard
S05 battery slider via keyboard re-solves in browser
every slider has an accessible name
kb.d: BATTERY POWER1,800 MW | BATTERY DURATION4 H | RENEWABLES MULTIPLIER×1.00 | RENEWABLES MULTIPLIER×1.00 | DEMAND GROWTH0% | HEAT WAVE+0.0 °C | BATTERY POWER1,500 MW | BATTERY DURATION4 H

kb.name: S06 tablist ArrowRight steps the scenario
CTRL GRID via keyboard
CTRL preset HEAT WAVE via keyboard
CTRL OUTAGE select via keyboard
CTRL LAYER PRICE via keyboard
CTRL TIME LIMIT too short: handled, last optimal kept, said on screen
kb.d: SOLVED IN BROWSER · HIGHS 1.15.1 (HIGHS-JS 1.15.3) · 4 MS SOLVER STATUS TIME LIMIT REACHED: SHOWING THE LAST OPTIMAL RESULT PARITY 108/108 VECTORS · OBJECTIVE WITHIN 1E-6 108/108 · PRICES 85/85 WHERE

kb.name: CTRL RESET restores CISO / first day / baseline params
CTRL RESET returns LAYER to STACK
CTRL inspector Enter/Esc returns focus to the rose
kb.d: div[button] "Control room rose. Enter or a click open" in #control
